Countdown Timer Widget

A simple countdown timer widget — set hours, minutes and seconds, start/pause/reset, with an audible alarm when time runs out.

00:00:00

📖 How to use

  1. Set hours, minutes and seconds (or use a preset).
  2. Press Start.
  3. Pause or reset anytime.
  4. Hear the alarm when it hits zero.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it play a sound when finished?

Yes — a chime plays when the countdown reaches zero (keep the tab open and volume up).

What is the maximum duration?

Up to 99 hours, 59 minutes, 59 seconds.

How precise is the display?

The display shows HH:MM:SS and updates every fraction of a second for smooth counting.

Does it keep running if I switch tabs?

Yes — the timer runs in the page; switching tabs keeps it counting.
